from datetime import date

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, date_day = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Calculate target month and year
    target_month = month + n
    target_year = year
    
    # Adjust year and month if needed
    while target_month > 12:
        target_month -= 12
        target_year += 1
    while target_month < 1:
        target_month += 12
        target_year -= 1
    
    # Determine the last day of the current month
    if month == 12:
        last_day_current = 31
    else:
        last_day_current = (date(year, month + 1, 1) - date(year, month, 1)).days
    
    # Check if the original day is the last day of its month
    is_last_day = (date_day == last_day_current)
    
    # Determine the last day of the target month
    if target_month == 12:
        last_day_target = 31
    else:
        last_day_target = (date(target_year, target_month + 1, 1) - date(target_year, target_month, 1)).days
    
    # Apply billing rule
    if is_last_day:
        result_day = last_day_target
    else:
        result_day = min(date_day, last_day_target)
    
    # Format and return
    return f"{target_year:04d}-{target_month:02d}-{result_day:02d}"
